subModule: Missing Mandatory Data Template → App Shell
taskDescription: Validate that Missing Mandatory Data Template module loads successfully within persistent AML application shell and renders all primary structural components without layout break, dependency failure, or route initialization issues.
acceptanceCriteria: AML shell loads successfully; Top bar persists; Sidebar renders; Template List Panel loads; Template Detail Panel loads; No broken rendering; Route initializes correctly; Layout remains stable after refresh.
preconditions: User logged in with authorized AML role; Module access enabled; Backend template API active.
testSteps: 1. Login to AML application. 2. Navigate to KYC → Missing Mandatory → Missing Mandatory Data Template. 3. Observe first-time module load. 4. Validate AML shell rendering. 5. Verify top bar. 6. Verify sidebar. 7. Validate left template list panel. 8. Validate right detail panel. 9. Check console/network failures. 10. Refresh and revalidate.
expectedResult: Module must load successfully within AML shell with stable top bar, sidebar, template list, and detail panel without broken UI, failed dependencies, or stale initialization.

taskDescription: Validate persistent top bar behavior and dynamic active view label updates across Template View, Create Template View, and KYC Gap Report.
acceptanceCriteria: Top bar remains persistent; Dynamic label updates correctly; Active module label reflects current state; No stale label persistence.
preconditions: User authenticated; Access available for all subviews.
testSteps: 1. Open Template view. 2. Validate top bar label. 3. Navigate to Create New Template. 4. Validate updated label. 5. Navigate to KYC Gap Report. 6. Validate label. 7. Navigate back. 8. Refresh and verify consistency.
expectedResult: Top bar must remain persistent and correctly display active view labels without stale navigation state.

taskDescription: Validate sidebar hierarchy under Missing Mandatory module and child-level navigation rendering.
acceptanceCriteria: Parent node visible; Expand/collapse works; Child routes visible; Active route highlighting persists.
testSteps: 1. Open AML shell. 2. Locate Missing Mandatory parent item. 3. Expand node. 4. Verify child routes. 5. Collapse node. 6. Expand again. 7. Validate route persistence. 8. Switch child nodes.
expectedResult: Sidebar should properly display Missing Mandatory hierarchy with correct child routes and navigation.

taskDescription: Validate navigation between Missing Mandatory Data Template and KYC Gap Report without route corruption or misrouting.
acceptanceCriteria: Template route opens correct view; Gap Report route opens correctly; No route misdirection; Navigation stable.
testSteps: 1. Expand Missing Mandatory. 2. Click Data Template. 3. Validate route. 4. Open KYC Gap Report. 5. Validate route. 6. Switch repeatedly. 7. Validate route integrity.
expectedResult: Correct module routes should open without navigation corruption.

taskDescription: Validate that switching between Template View and KYC Gap Report does not reset filters, pagination, or selected view context.
acceptanceCriteria: State persists; Filters retained; Pagination retained; Selected template retained.
preconditions: Templates available; Gap report data available.
testSteps: 1. Open Template view. 2. Select non-default template. 3. Navigate to Gap Report. 4. Apply filters. 5. Change pagination. 6. Return to Template view. 7. Validate selected template persistence. 8. Reopen Gap Report. 9. Validate filter persistence.
expectedResult: Cross-view switching should preserve operational state without unexpected reset.

expectedResult: Template List Panel should group templates accurately by customer type.

preconditions: Score engine active; Configured score bands available.
testSteps: 1. Open customer profiles with varying missing fields. 2. Compare computed scores. 3. Validate mapped risk category.
testData: Low missing fields vs High missing fields
expectedResult: System must consistently interpret higher KYC Gap Score as worse compliance.

expectedResult: A customer with no missing fields must return score 0 and map to Low risk.
